⚙ Settings & User Guide

🖼 Background & Images

Main BG
Background Image — Drop or click to upload your primary photo. Use Image Scale, Frame Size, and position sliders (Left/Right, Top/Bottom) to frame it perfectly.
Extra
Image 2 & Image 3 — Used by multi-image templates like Grid Mosaic (#16) and Photo Collage (#31). Upload extras here.
GIF
Decoration GIF — Overlays a sparkle or animation on top of every template. Use a transparent-background GIF for best results.

🎨 Brand Palette

Slot 2 is permanently locked to your brand colors so they're always one click away. Click any palette chip in the top bar to switch themes instantly.
Chips
The color bar in the topbar shows 6 saved palette slots. Click any to apply it. Hover to reveal a clear (×) button.
Custom
The Custom Palette Bar below the topbar lets you override individual color roles (BG, Primary, Accent, etc.) without changing the base palette.
Save
Hit 💾 Save to slot to write your current custom palette to the active slot. Use 🎲 Scramble to randomly remix colors for inspiration.

🔤 Text & Typography

Header
The Header Text is your main title or hook. Choose font, size, alignment, line height, letter spacing, drop shadow, and outline thickness.
Body
The Body Text is your caption, CTA, or message. Independently styled from the header with its own font and color override.
Badge
The Website/Handle Badge appears as a branded tag on every post. Set your URL and choose position (bottom center, top right, etc.).
Use Position Offset sliders (Left/Right and Top/Bottom) under each text element to fine-tune placement on templates that need it. Hit ↺ to reset to default.

🪟 Logo Management

Slots
You have 6 logo slots — upload different logos or brand marks. Click a slot to activate it. The active slot (highlighted) is the logo shown on templates.
Position
Use the Logo Position preset (TL, TC, TR, BL, BC, BR) for quick placement, then fine-tune with X/Y offset sliders.

⬇ Downloading Posts

Single
Click the ⬇ save icon on any template card to download just that one post at full resolution.
Batch
Check the checkboxes on multiple cards, then click ⬇ Download Selected in the bar that appears above the grid.
All
Use ⬇ All 88 at the bottom of the sidebar to download your entire template set at once.
Set a Filename Prefix in Download Settings so files are organized and easy to find: e.g., SpringCampaign_0001.png

PostPilot Integration

Send
Select posts and click Send to PostPilot to queue them for scheduling. You'll be prompted to choose which platform(s) to send to.
New user? Follow these 6 steps to create your first batch of branded posts in under 5 minutes.
1
Upload your brand image

Drag a photo into the Background Image zone in the sidebar. Use the Scale and Position sliders to frame it exactly how you want.

2
Upload your logo

Click any of the 6 logo slots to upload your logo. Click it again to make it the active logo shown on posts.

3
Enter your text

Type your header (main title) and body copy (caption/CTA). Set your website URL for the badge at the bottom of every post.

4
Choose your palette

Click a palette chip in the topbar to switch color themes. Slot 2 is always your brand colors. Use the Custom bar to override individual colors.

5
Pick your platform

Use the Platform tabs (Instagram, Pinterest, Google Biz) to switch canvas sizes. Your content re-renders instantly for each format.

6
Download your posts

Click ☑ All to select everything, then hit ⬇ Download Selected — or use ⬇ All 88 in the sidebar for a full batch download.

✅ You're all set!
All settings auto-save as you work. Your uploads, text, palette, and preferences are restored the next time you open the app.

⚡ Speed Tips

Fast
Paste images directly — You can paste (Ctrl/Cmd+V) a copied image right into the background upload zone without clicking Browse.
Fast
Click a preview image to quickly open the full-size Preview Panel for that card.
Fast
Scramble palette (🎲 button in the custom bar) shuffles your current 6 colors into different role positions — background becomes accent, accent becomes highlight, etc. No new colors are introduced, so your brand identity stays intact while you remix the layout.

🎨 Design Tips

Pro
Overlay Opacity — Raise it to make text pop over busy photos. Lower it for a more lifestyle, editorial feel.
Pro
Text Panel Width — On split-layout templates, slide to 0 to hide text area completely or 100 to fill the entire canvas for text-only cards.
Pro
Header Outline — A subtle 1–2px outline in a contrasting color makes headlines readable on any background.
Pro
Duotone templates (e.g., #19 Duotone Wash) look best when your Accent and BG colors have high contrast.

📐 Batch Strategy Tips

Strategy
Run the same content through all 3 platforms to get Instagram square, Pinterest tall, and Google landscape versions in one session.
Strategy
Use the Filename Prefix field to tag batches by campaign, e.g., Spring24_Auto so files stay organized in your downloads folder.
Strategy
The ⊞ All Platforms button in the Preview Panel shows all 3 platform versions side by side for a quick sanity check before downloading.
Keyboard shortcuts work when focus is not inside a text field.

⌨ Keyboard Shortcuts

Ctrl/Cmd + V

Escape

Ctrl/Cmd + A

Ctrl/Cmd + D

🖱 Mouse & Drag Actions

Drag
Drag the resize handle on the left edge of the Preview Panel to expand or shrink it.
Hover
Hover over a template card to reveal Download (⬇), Preview, and Copy (📋) quick-action buttons.
Click
Click the preview image of a card to open it in the full Preview Panel instantly.
Drag
On color swatches, click to open the hex editor. Use the 💧 EyeDropper to pick any color from your screen.
